financing.summary: Hovnanian is one of the most option-heavy public builders: 87% of its 34,373 domestic controlled lots were optioned at July 31, 2026, the highest share in its history, and it describes its approach as a 'land-light strategic focus'. It pays for control with deposits ($348.8M of cash deposits against $3.4B of optioned land and lots) and with sale-and-option-back land banking that it books as financing ($285.1M of land-banked inventory not owned and a $164.9M liability at July 31, 2026, up from $164.9M and $94.1M at October 31, 2024); it also recycles capital by contributing communities to unconsolidated joint ventures. Corporate debt was fully refinanced in September 2025 into $900M of unsecured notes due 2031 and 2033 (8.0% and 8.375%), leaving no note maturity before April 2031 and an undrawn $125M secured revolver to June 2028. Liquidity was $379.8M at July 31, 2026 against a stated target of $170M to $245M. No land banker, option counterparty or JV partner is named in the filings opened, so the room for a land banker is large in volume but the current split between providers is not public.
financing.land_strategy: Land-light, in the company's own words ('land-light strategic focus', 'disciplined land-light strategy'). The 10-K says it prefers a 'risk-averse land acquisition strategy' and acquires land through options where possible. No numeric target for the optioned share is stated; the actual share rose from 85% (Oct 31, 2025) to 86% (Jan 31 and Apr 30, 2026) to 87% (Jul 31, 2026). Land banking is done by selling parcels to a land banker and taking an option to buy back finished lots on a schedule.

lots.source_title: Hovnanian Enterprises Reports Fiscal 2026 Third Quarter Results (8-K Exhibit 99.1)
lots.note: Domestic consolidated lots only (excludes unconsolidated JVs and the Saudi Arabia business). The release gives the total, the 87% optioned share and 6.8 years' supply on trailing twelve-month deliveries, but not the owned and optioned counts; 87% implies roughly 29,900 optioned and 4,500 owned (derived, not published in the release). The exact owned/optioned table by segment is in the 10-Q MD&A, which could not be loaded in this run. Trend: 40,246 lots at Jul 31, 2025; 35,883 at Oct 31, 2025 (85% optioned); 35,560 at Jan 31, 2026 (86%); 33,632 at Apr 30, 2026 (86%). About 3,000 lots were optioned or acquired in Q3 FY2026 and 962 were walked away from (3,712 in the nine months).
